author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: OnLogic has introduced the Factor 101, a compact fanless industrial system built around Qualcomm’s QCS6490 platform. The unit targets edge deployments that need wired networking, basic display output, and local inference acceleration in a small enclosure. title: Fanless Factor 101 Arrives with Qualcomm QCS6490 and 10GbE Networking

author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: The ESP32 Bus Pirate project, originally introduced as a modern ESP32-S3 adaptation of the classic Bus Pirate debugging tool, has received a substantial update expanding its protocol support, signal analysis capabilities, and RF experimentation features. title: ESP32 Bus Pirate Update Adds RF Tools, USB Host Mode, Signal Analysis, and Cellular Plans

author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Collabora has announced GStreamer 1.28, expanding its machine learning and AI inference capabilities for media pipelines. title: GStreamer 1.28 Adds AI Inference Engines, YOLO Decoders, and Tensor Auto-Discovery
